author: Good Enough
description:
Let's take a deep dive into the real dangers behind some of nature’s most destructive events and the practical steps that can help keep you alive when seconds matter. This video breaks down how seemingly common threats like hailstorms can shatter glass and cause serious injuries, and why sandstorms become deadly through zero visibility and lung-damaging dust. It explores how blizzards combine cold, wind, and whiteout conditions to create rapid hypothermia risk, and how extreme wind events such as derechos can produce destructive forces comparable to weaker tornadoes. We also examine the fast-moving and unpredictable behavior of wildfires, the warning signs of dry mass movements like rockfalls and landslides, and the hidden dangers inside severe thunderstorms, including lightning strikes and sudden flash flooding.

title: How to Survive Every Natural Disaster
